infotexts.afflictiondescription.aic_heat_buildup.l: Heat is building up across the target surface or armor. Physical performance is not yet affected, but burn protection is weakening.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.aic_heat_buildup.m: The target surface or armor is melting. Protection against multiple damage types is falling. Do not rapidly cool with seawater; flash boiling may occur.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.aic_heat_buildup.h: The target surface or armor is nearly melted through. Defensive performance is severely reduced, continuous burns are occurring, and further heating may cause a flash fire.
infotexts.entitydescription.aic_gdf_downpour_smg: A compact GDF ricochet-submachine gun designed to suppress close-range targets in confined compartments with a high rate of fire. Originally intended for security aboard surface vessels and indoor facilities, its hybrid propellant-gas and electromagnetic propulsion system was not designed with hull damage control in mind.
infotexts.entitydescription.aic_gdf_stiletto_pdw: A compact, agile GDF personal defense weapon for vehicle crews and specialist support personnel. It uses hybrid propellant-gas and electromagnetic propulsion, though its short frame reduces electromagnetic acceleration efficiency. Can be fired one-handed.
infotexts.entitydescription.aic_gdf_small_magazine: A standard GDF thirty-round compact military magazine loaded with tungsten-core flechettes. Small, but far from weak.
infotexts.entitydescription.aic_gdf_personal_defen: A manufacturing blueprint detailing the construction, materials, and assembly of GDF personal defense weapons. Read it to permanently unlock fabrication recipes for the Stiletto PDW and Downpour SMG, along with fabrication and recycling recipes for GDF military small magazines.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.aic_machine_struct: The machine's structure is slightly deformed or internally fractured, weakening its protection against electromagnetic shocks.
The machine's load-bearing frame and inner armor are severely damaged and can no longer effectively isolate electromagnetic shocks.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.aic_machine_compon: Minor faults in internal components and transmission systems are beginning to slow the machine.
Internal components and transmission systems are severely damaged, substantially reducing the machine's mobility.
infotexts.faction.aic_wardens_pmc.description: Wardens PMC is an armed organization of mysterious origin, composed of experienced security personnel, engineering specialists, and military veterans. It works closely with the Europa Coalition, primarily undertaking armed escort, hazardous-zone exploration, and facility defense contracts while assisting with the construction of surface defense systems. With advanced protective equipment and extensive experience in responding to biological hazards, the Wardens are gradually becoming a major security force on Europa.
infotexts.faction.aic_wardens_pmc.shortdescription: Wardens PMC is an armed security organization working closely with the Europa Coalition on escort, hazardous-zone exploration, and facility defense operations.
infotexts.faction.aic_gdf_contribution.description: Points recording the crew's contributions, redeemable for supplies through special Wardens event stores.
infotexts.faction.aic_gdf_contribution.shortdescri: GDF contribution points used for special Wardens exchanges.
infotexts.missiondescription.aic_cargo_surface_fac: The Europa Coalition is coordinating large shipments of engineering materials to construct and reinforce facilities on Europa's icy surface. The building program urgently needs structural steel, titanium-aluminium alloy, and tungsten steel delivered safely to [location2].
infotexts.missiondescription.aic_investigate_unkno: The Europa Coalition has received multiple reports of unidentified attacks in these waters. Investigate the reported area, identify the source of the threat, and eliminate it completely.
infotexts.missiondescription.aic_transport_wardens: A Wardens combat detachment must reach [location2] to relieve the local facility security detail. Safely transport two assaulters and two marksmen to their destination.
infotexts.eventtext.aic_wardens_dispatcher.greetin: Looking for work? I still have several Coalition contracts assigned to the Wardens.
We are here to take on some missions.
infotexts.eventtext.aic_wardens_dispatcher.mission: Understood. I will transmit the assignments no one has taken yet to your terminal. The objectives and compensation are included in the briefs.
I want to exchange contribution points for supplies.
infotexts.eventtext.aic_wardens_dispatcher.store.r: (Checks the roster.) New around here? I have not seen you before. Complete a few contracts and come back.
infotexts.eventtext.aic_wardens_dispatcher.store.d: Perhaps you could make an exception. (Bribe: 2,000 mk)
infotexts.eventtext.aic_wardens_dispatcher.store.k: The Wardens are a legitimate Coalition contractor. An exception? Get out before I call an inspector.
infotexts.eventtext.aic_wardens_dispatcher.bribe.g: You catch on quickly. Marks alone cannot buy supplies without contribution points, though. I could sell you a few.
infotexts.eventtext.aic_wardens_dispatcher.bribe.o: I already saved some contribution points. I do not need any.
I will take some. (1,000 mk for 2 Contribution Points)
infotexts.eventtext.aic_wardens_dispatcher.store.b: Do not tell anyone about this. Now, what do you need?
infotexts.eventtext.aic_wardens_dispatcher.store.l: (Checks the roster.) Your crew is authorized to exchange supplies. I hope you brought enough marks and contribution points.
We need materials for manufacturing ammunition and armor. (2 GDF Contribution Points, 1,500 mk)
I need guns. Lots of guns. (3 Legion Assault Rifles, 8 standard magazines, 8 depleted radioactive magazines; 2 GDF Contribution Points, 1,500 mk)
I need guns. Lots of guns. (2 GDF Contribution Points, 1,600 mk)
I am short on marks. (Exchange 1 GDF Contribution Point for 400 mk)
Exchange for the GDF Personal Defense Weapon Blueprint. (10 GDF Contribution Points, 2,000 mk)
Here are your supplies. Check the contents now; missing items will not be replaced later.
You cannot afford that. Complete a couple more contracts and come back.
Your contribution balance is insufficient. Complete more contracts before requesting another exchange.
Your account does not contain enough marks.
infotexts.eventtext.aic_wardens_dispatcher.firstto: You notice a soldier in heavy exoskeleton armor standing beside the outpost recruitment board while station personnel gather around him.
You still have your first voyage to prepare for. Someone else can satisfy their curiosity.

You push through the crowd and approach the recruitment board. The soldier's exoskeleton bears no Coalition military insignia, only a black-and-white fortress emblem.
“Good timing, everyone.”
He raises an armored hand and quiets the crowd.
“The Coalition is constructing communications and observation facilities on Europa's surface in an effort to reestablish contact with Earth. The environment is hostile, and every worker and machine must travel by submarine. The Coalition's engineering corps cannot handle that traffic alone.”
“They need builders, equipment operators, escorts, and crews capable of delivering supplies to the surface elevators. The Coalition and the Wardens guarantee the pay, and participating crews earn contribution points exchangeable for supplies unavailable on the open market.”

“I neglected to introduce myself. Sergeant Edwin, liaison for the Wardens PMC. We are a Coalition-authorized security contractor responsible for convoy escort, hazardous exploration, and facility defense. The Coalition retained us to support the surface construction program.”
“You will not need armor like mine to wrestle monsters. Most positions involve transport, construction, or maintenance. But the surface routes are dangerous. Every recruit is eligible for basic Warden training, free of charge, so they know how to stay alive when the alarms sound.”
He pins a new assignment sheet to the board and looks your way.
“Are you looking for work?”
I am a new captain with a submarine and a crew. What work do you have?

Edwin studies you, then checks his terminal.
“A new captain? Excellent.”
He opens a freight manifest.
“A shipment of steel, titanium-aluminum alloy, and tungsten steel for the surface works is still sitting in storage. Coalition transports are stretched thin. Deliver it to the next outpost intact and the contract is complete.”
He transfers the assignment to your terminal.
“The Wardens are also converting an old beacon station into a temporary training facility. Once it is ready, I will send you the induction course coordinates.”
He taps the armor over his chest.
“Europa does not go easy on beginners. Learn what you can before your first breach or boarding action.”

“Station personnel will load the cargo. The route, destination, and compensation are on your terminal. Complete this delivery and the Wardens will record your performance. Keep your boat and crew reliable, and better-paying work will follow.”
Return to the submarine and prepare.
infotexts.entitydescription.aic_disintegration_fie: A throwable Higgs-field disruption device. Once activated, it emits expanding decoupling waves that compromise armor, movement, weapon control, and the target's internal structure.
